name: Ama Futa Sandwich!!! -AMA-AMA-FUTA-MATA-SANDWICH!!!-
original_name: あまふたサンドイッチ！！！ -AMA-AMA-FUTA-MATA-SANDWICH!!!-
source:
Follow the life of the college-student protagonist as a girl named Kogoeto Honori unexpectedly moves into his house, and starts living there as if it were perfectly normal! The rest of the cast gradually assembles, and it's a ready-made harem comedy that's just the sort of scenario INO's work thrives in. You can practically feel the lush curves of the bishoujo illustrations under your hands as you play through the many romantic scenes with the game's cast, and with the title literally meaning "sweet, sweet thigh sandwich", you know you're headed for a wonderfully ecchi gaming experience.

[From J-List]
translation:
故事跟随一名大学生主人公展开：名叫冻户仄里的少女意外搬进他家，并像这一切理所当然般开始同居！其他角色逐渐聚齐，构成了INO作品最擅长的那种现成后宫喜剧。游玩与角色们共度的众多恋爱场景时，你几乎能隔着画面感受到美少女插画丰润的曲线；而标题直译便是“甜甜夹腿三明治”，你自然知道自己将迎来一段绝妙的色情游戏体验。

[摘自J-List]
